name: fs_getfilep

ownership.argument: Resolve and retain the calling task group fd file object; release with fs_putfilep. Must run in the owning group for a foreign-loop fd.

provenance.source: Exact Q66 .155 IDB recovery for fd-independent QJS event-loop notification, 2026-10-30; native async wake EBADF captured at C3F5758.

notes: Private exact-target ABI record; not public callable approval or physical validation. Entry bytes: b0 b5 00 24 0e 4a 0c 60 12 68 03 46. NuttX file slots are 32 bytes (C332B70). File references increment under interrupt critical section (C332B78-C332B7E).
